Class SyncDataSource.SingleFieldValidationDataSource<U,T,ID>

java.lang.Object
org.quark.synq.SyncDataSource.AbstractReflectedDataSource<U,T>
org.quark.synq.SyncDataSource.SingleFieldValidationDataSource<U,T,ID>
Type Parameters:
U - The type of user object used by the application
T - The type of entity this data source knows how to handle
ID - The type of the field by which access is determined
All Implemented Interfaces:
SyncDataSource<U,T>
Enclosing interface:
SyncDataSource<U,T>
public abstract static class SyncDataSource.SingleFieldValidationDataSource<U,T,ID> extends SyncDataSource.AbstractReflectedDataSource<U,T>
A simple data source for the use case where a user's access to an entity can be determined from the value of a single field on the entity.

    • validateSubscription

      public SyncDataSource.ValidationMaintainer<U> validateSubscription(U user, Map<String, SyncDataSource.SyncDataFilter<T>> filters) throws UnsupportedOperationException
      Description copied from interface: SyncDataSource
      Creates a validation maintainer for a user's subscription
      Parameters:
      user - The user requesting the subscription
      filters - The filters requested by the user, by type name
      Returns:
      A function to be called for every entity event that occurs in the service to ensure the subscription remains valid.
      When an event does not invalidate this subscription, null should be returned.
      If an event occurs which means the user no longer has access to the data for this entity source and the given filter, the function should return a list of the entities that the user no longer has access to.
      These entities will be sent as removals to the client along with the notification that the subscription has been cancelled.
      Throws:
      UnsupportedOperationException - If the user does not have access to the data from this data source with the given filters.

    • queryEntities

      public List<T> queryEntities(List<Map<String, SyncDataSource.SyncDataFilter<T>>> filters)
      Description copied from interface: SyncDataSource
      Gets the initial set of entities currently in the data source matching any of a list of filter sets for a set of subscriptions to this data source's entity set
      Parameters:
      filters - The filters to apply
      Returns:
      All entities in the data set which match any of the given filter combos.
      THIS METHOD MUST NOT FILTER BASED ON PERMISSIONS or any other criterion other than the filters parameter.
      The opportunity for permission checks happens in SyncDataSource.validateSubscription(Object, Map).
